sampson_distance — 3D two_view op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sampson_distance(F, pts1, pts2) (to call the implementation directly, import twoview; twoview.sampson_distance(F, pts1, pts2); from the registry, ops3d.get("sampson_distance"))

Usage

The Sampson distance of the epipolar constraint (the first-order geometric error, per correspondence). → (N,).

Raises ValueError: points are not (N,2) / non-finite / correspondence counts mismatch.

Computation: with homogeneous coordinates x1=(u1,v1,1), x2=(u2,v2,1), (x2ᵀ F x1)² / ((F x1)_0² + (F x1)_1² + (Fᵀ x2)_0² + (Fᵀ x2)_1² + 1e-12).

• The unit is the 2nd power of pixels (the 2nd power of distance). To threshold in pixels, take sqrt or raise the threshold to the power 2.

• F follows the convention of fundamental_8point, x2ᵀ F x1 = 0 (pts1 → x1, pts2 → x2). If you swap the order, transpose F.

• Since 1e-12 is added to the denominator, even F=0 raises no exception and returns 0 (F is not checked).

• The return value is float64 (N,). Deterministic. Not (N,2), non-finite, or mismatched point counts give ValueError.

• Typical: checking the fit of fundamental_8point, sorting out mismatches (large values), preprocessing before recover_pose.
